title: sig'last_value written to a clocked target — Tier 4.1 close-out fence
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Writes `d_reg'last_value` onto a clocked target `q_prev` inside a rising_edge(clk) process. Pre-close-out, this crashed at t=15 ns because ScheduledOperation.Execute never grew the DeferredAttribute dispatch branch (Operation.Execute did in Tier 4.1) and the RHS item silently dropped from the stack, tripping the malformed-expression guard. With the branch restored, the sim must run to completion and produce q_prev tracking d_reg's pre-transition value cycle by cycle.
